content.title: Extract shared e2e API base URL constant
content.description:
Follow-up discovered while planning port standardization (mqh2hw1wl3).

The e2e specs hardcode the API base URL. phase1 and phase2 inline `http://localhost:3001/...` in 63 places; phase3/phase4/dashboard/url-filters each define a local `const BASE`.

Proposal: export a single `E2E_API_BASE` (and optionally consume Playwright's `baseURL`-derived value) from `e2e/setup.ts` and import it in all specs. This makes future port changes a 1-line edit and removes a class of breakage where the playwright.config.ts port moves but specs lag behind.

Scope: refactor only, no behavior change. Must keep all 152 tests green.
